review_method.execution: Static local reads, original-image views and writing this assigned report only. No tests/builds/probes, SSH, copy/crop, image processing or new programs.
review_method.scope: Only frozen C4 DC source/binary evidence; no changing C5 production is used. Overall suite remains mechanically incomplete.
